text:
Jen (People Ops): @Alyssa quick heads up — Kayla's start is tomorrow 9am EST. She completed e-forms but opted for in-person I-9 verification. Need a plan by EOD.

Alyssa (Hiring Manager): Can we do office drop-in? Kayla said she can't make it to SF — NYC office is under renovation this week.

Samir (IT): Laptop shipped today via Pipe (tracking X123). If we need to send a courier to verify docs we can include pickup label.

Jen (People Ops): Options: 1) Use authorized agent (ClearHire) to verify I-9, 2) send company courier to Kayla's address (needs consent), 3) have Kayla visit local notary + we accept scanned docs + agent attestation. Compliance preference?

Compliance (HR): We prefer vendor attestation (ClearHire) for remote hires. If using courier, must have signed consent form + two-person chain of custody. Also FYI — background check returned an 'address mismatch' alert; we need proof of current address before final clearance.

BackgroundBot: BG Check — Kayla Nguyen — Status: RED — Address mismatch on file. Action required: upload one of [utility bill, bank stmt] dated within 60 days.

Kayla Nguyen: Hi all — I can do ClearHire, or I can drop by a notarized agent tomorrow afternoon. I have a bank statement PDF ready. Do you have the ClearHire link?

Jen (People Ops): @Kayla please DM me the statement. We can submit to ClearHire — here's the intake form: https://clearhire.example.com/intake?ref=redwood — they do same-day verification if scheduled this morning.

Alyssa (Hiring Manager): If ClearHire confirms, can Samir still deliver laptop to her home? We need to ensure secure delivery/wipe policy if address differs.

Samir (IT): Yes. I'll recheck shipping address. If BG needs address proof we should hold delivery until confirmed; we can also loan a hotspot if there's a delay.

Courier Ops: If opting courier, please fill ops form: ops.redwood/field-verify with preferred time window. Courier availability limited after 3pm.

Jen (People Ops): Plan: Kayla to send doc now; we'll try ClearHire first; if scheduling conflicts, courier fallback. Kayla — once you upload, I'll confirm with Compliance and cc Samir on laptop release.

Kayla Nguyen: Uploaded bank statement to DM. Thanks!

Compliance (HR): Received. We'll submit to ClearHire and update BG vendor. Please do not ship laptop until we mark BG green. Jen — please add note for canary access if needed.

Jen (People Ops): Noted. Alyssa — can you delay the welcome calendar invite to 11am EST? We might need extra time.

Alyssa (Hiring Manager): Done — moved to 12pm EST to be safe. :thumbsup:

BackgroundBot: BG Check — Kayla Nguyen — Status: GREEN (manual reconcile) — cleared 2025-05-14 10:12 UTC

Samir (IT): Laptop release scheduled for tomorrow 9am local courier pickup. Tracking X123 updated.

Kayla Nguyen: Appreciate everyone — see you tomorrow at 12 for orientation! :)

Jen (People Ops): Closing loop: courier only if ClearHire fails. Thanks team.
